About me

I’m a video editor with around 1.5 years of professional experience, working with Shady Habashy — تاريخ وكورافيا on high-volume social media content.

My work focuses on selecting the strongest moments from longer content, tightening pacing, restructuring material into clear standalone pieces, and adding creative visual touches where they improve the story. My published portfolio is mainly sports-focused, but the editing skills behind it — pacing, storytelling, content selection and audience retention — transfer directly to other types of digital content.

I’ve contributed to content that helped drive 500K+ follower growth and reach millions of views across social platforms.
